job.style: a step-by-step explanation of a process

response.passage: Many people think sleep is just the body switching off like a machine, but it is actually a busy, active process. While you rest, your brain is hard at work processing memories from your day and clearing out waste. One of the most important things that happens during deep sleep is the release of growth hormones, which help your body grow taller and stronger. This is why sleep is essential for physical development, not just food or exercise. Your internal body clock is also sensitive to light; the blue light from screens signals your brain to stay alert, making it harder to fall asleep. Because of this, using a phone in bed actually prevents you from relaxing properly. Furthermore, sleep is not a single, steady state; your brain cycles through different stages of activity all night long. Many students believe that staying awake all night to study before an exam is a good idea, but this is a mistake. Without enough sleep, your brain struggles to store information, and you will likely perform worse. Finally, you cannot simply 'catch up' on lost sleep by sleeping extra hours on the weekend. Your body needs a consistent daily rhythm to function at its best, and missing sleep affects your entire health, not just your energy levels.
response.summary: Sleep is an active process where the brain processes memories and the body releases growth hormones. Using screens at night and skipping sleep for studies negatively impacts your health and performance.
